catalogue_metadata.scope_notes: Extraction from cas_runner continuous architecture steering framework, covering governance action engines, agentic knowledge merging, steering models, and pipeline execution flows.
analysis_limits: Repository source code and documentation inspection only
Dynamic execution traces and runtime evaluation logs not actively executed

system_map.overview: cas_runner provides a continuous architecture steering engine that coordinates LLM-assisted governance, compliance evaluation, and automated knowledge merging across repositories using structured prompt facts and capability state models.

agents.name: AgenticMerger
agents.role: Reconciles and synthesizes architectural knowledge and governance updates across branches or project workspaces using LLM prompts.

agents.name: GovernanceActionEngine
agents.role: Enforces deterministic state transitions and executes approved actions over governance lifecycles based on compliance findings.

agents.name: ComplianceEngine
agents.role: Evaluates architectural and steering artifacts against predefined rules and generates compliance metrics and findings.

orchestration.description: FlowRunner coordinates pipeline execution sequentially, loading execution context, running compliance engines, invoking agentic merging, and recording telemetry state.

tools_and_integrations.name: LiteLLMClient
tools_and_integrations.purpose: Provides unified abstraction over diverse LLM backend providers for prompt completion and synthesis.

tools_and_integrations.name: MockLLMClient
tools_and_integrations.purpose: Deterministic offline mock client mimicking LLM provider responses for testing and local validation.

tools_and_integrations.name: OpenTelemetry Instrumentation
tools_and_integrations.purpose: Tracks telemetry, execution metrics, and latency across runner stages.

state_and_memory.description: Steering runtime indexes, capability records, and rule contexts stored as JSON and YAML files.
Governance health scores and compliance findings calculated from current inventory and historical traces.
Flow execution contexts, raw git deltas, and in-flight prompt facts during steering projection runs.

patterns.name: Agentic Knowledge Merger

tool_protocols.notes: Invokes completion models to resolve conflicts between branch state and architecture intent.

optimisation_targets.notes: Ensures architectural knowledge is reconciled without human intervention on mechanical conflicts.

simplicity_vs_autonomy.rationale: Automates diff resolution while enforcing structured pydantic models on outputs.

patterns.summary: Delegates semantic conflict reconciliation and knowledge base integration to an LLM agent that outputs validated resolution artifacts.
patterns.intent: Resolve divergent governance blocks and architecture documentation without manual text merging by using prompt-contextualized agent synthesis.
patterns.context: Used during repository synchronization and steering updates when branch artifacts or governance docs diverge.
forces: Git merge conflicts in narrative or JSON knowledge files break automated CI pipelines
Pure mechanical diff tools fail to capture domain semantics in architecture documentation
patterns.solution: AgenticMerger ingests source conflicts, applies contextual instructions and prompt facts, calls the LLM client, and parses results into structured ResolutionResult objects.
implementation_signals: Class named AgenticMerger handling reconciliation logic

evidence.note: Defines agent-based merge mechanism using LLM clients to reconcile governance changes.
Typed contract containing resolution state, merged content, and diagnostic notes.

benefits: Eliminates trivial manual conflict resolution in automated steering flows
Maintains structural validity of knowledge files
costs: Requires token consumption and LLM latency during merges
Potential subtle semantic hallucinations during resolution
failure_modes: Agent produces unparseable JSON/YAML or hallucinates removed governance rules

patterns.reuse_notes: Extractable to any system handling multi-branch documentation or knowledge synchronization.

patterns.name: State Transition Registry Guardrail

tool_protocols.notes: Deterministic state transitions guarding autonomous and automated actions.

optimisation_targets.notes: Prevents unauthorized or illegal governance status jumps by autonomous agents.

simplicity_vs_autonomy.rationale: Strictly constrains agent actions to predefined lifecycle transitions.

patterns.summary: Constrains governance and agent actions through an explicit transition registry that validates allowed state mutations before execution.
patterns.intent: Prevent LLM or autonomous processes from executing arbitrary state transitions or skipping required compliance gates.
patterns.context: Surrounds all governance actions and lifecycle changes in cas_runner.
forces: Autonomous agents need to progress architecture artifacts through lifecycles
Directly allowing agents to set arbitrary status allows governance bypass
patterns.solution: Implement a TransitionRegistry and GovernanceActionEngine that validates the current state against valid next states prior to committing changes.
implementation_signals: TransitionRegistry class defining allowed state movements

evidence.note: Encapsulates valid transition definitions and checks every action against registered routes.

benefits: Guarantees lifecycle integrity across automated runs
Eliminates deadlocks and illegal lifecycle jumps
costs: New lifecycle states require updating registry code
failure_modes: Governance action attempts an unregistered transition and throws GovernanceException

patterns.reuse_notes: Apply wherever agents trigger workflows with critical audit and compliance requirements.

patterns.name: Prompt-Fact Steering Projection

tool_protocols.notes: Extracts raw git deltas into structured prompt facts for downstream steering projections.

optimisation_targets.notes: Condenses unstructured codebase deltas into grounded factual representations.

simplicity_vs_autonomy.rationale: Converts code change noise into discrete verifiable facts for prompts.

patterns.summary: Transforms raw VCS change sets and codebase deltas into structured, typed prompt facts before feeding them to downstream reasoning steps.
patterns.intent: Ground agent reasoning on verified changes rather than unconstrained raw diff strings.
patterns.context: Used in steering calculation to determine architectural impact of git modifications.
forces: Raw diffs can overflow context windows and contain irrelevant whitespace changes
Agents hallucinate architectural intent without factual grounding in code deltas
patterns.solution: Define RawGitDelta and PromptFact models to extract semantic capabilities and lineage facts passed to the agent context.
implementation_signals: PromptFact model with categorized evidence references

evidence.note: Provides data structures linking raw git changes to structured facts.
Documents the end-to-end projection flow from git delta to steering index.

benefits: Reduces prompt token size by summarizing deltas into facts
Ensures reproducibility of architectural impact calculations
costs: Requires pre-processing logic to derive facts from diffs
failure_modes: Delta extractor misses subtle semantic changes not reflected in basic file diff heuristics

patterns.reuse_notes: Useful in developer tools and coding agents that need to interpret commit history or pull request deltas.

patterns.name: Provider-Agnostic LLM Adapter with Mock Isolation

tool_protocols.notes: Wraps multi-provider completions via LiteLLM with a parallel deterministic mock implementation.

optimisation_targets.notes: Enables hermetic CI test execution without token expenditure or network dependencies.

simplicity_vs_autonomy.rationale: Separates transport and model vendor specifics from core agent reasoning.

patterns.summary: Abstracts LLM invocations behind a uniform adapter using LiteLLM alongside a mirrored mock client for offline testing and deterministic runs.
patterns.intent: Decouple orchestration and agent logic from specific model providers while allowing cost-free offline verification.
patterns.context: Core dependency for FlowRunner and AgenticMerger across development and production environments.
forces: Binding agent logic directly to vendor SDKs limits model agility
CI pipelines cannot reliably make external paid API calls due to cost and non-determinism
patterns.solution: Expose LiteLLMClient and MockLLMClient sharing uniform call signatures and returning consistent message envelopes.
implementation_signals: MockLLMClient returning deterministic canned fixtures or heuristic responses

evidence.note: Mock implementation allowing local and CI test execution without real API credentials.

benefits: Zero-cost deterministic tests in CI/CD pipelines
Seamless switching between OpenAI, Anthropic, or local model backends
costs: Mock responses can drift from actual LLM behavioral nuances
failure_modes: Mock client fails to simulate schema parsing errors seen with real model outputs

patterns.reuse_notes: Standard foundational pattern for all agentic pipelines requiring automated testing.

patterns.name: Compliance-First Guardrail Engine

tool_protocols.notes: Validates runtime decisions and artifacts against pre-configured rules.

optimisation_targets.notes: Blocks changes violating architectural rules before promotion.

simplicity_vs_autonomy.rationale: Automates validation but enforces hard barriers against non-compliant states.

patterns.summary: Executes rule evaluation prior to artifact promotion, generating structured compliance metrics and findings that govern workflow completion.
patterns.intent: Ensure all agentic modifications and governance assets adhere to architectural constraints prior to merging or deployment.
patterns.context: Executed as a mandatory step in cas_runner prior to governance actions.
forces: Autonomous code and doc modifications can introduce violations of organizational rules
Manual review of every minor change creates an operational bottleneck
patterns.solution: ComplianceEngine reads rule-context.json, executes checks, and produces ComplianceMetrics with a list of ComplianceFinding objects.

evidence.note: Evaluates compliance rules against current workspace inventory.
Models encapsulating compliance infractions and aggregate score metrics.

benefits: Audit trail of compliance findings over time
costs: Must maintain rule context definitions up-to-date
failure_modes: Outdated rule schemas cause false-positive rejections of valid architectural updates

patterns.reuse_notes: Applicable to any agentic system requiring automated policy gates before writing changes to codebases.

patterns.name: Capability Lineage and Provenance Tracking

tool_protocols.notes: Tracks genealogical provenance of generated capability records.

optimisation_targets.notes: Provides unambiguous tracing from final decisions back to origin deltas and prompts.

simplicity_vs_autonomy.rationale: Adds explicit metadata fields for provenance to structured entities.

patterns.summary: Attaches explicit provenance and lineage metadata to generated architectural records, tracing origins to specific diffs and facts.
patterns.intent: Maintain an immutable record of why, how, and from which inputs an agent produced or updated an architectural capability.
patterns.context: Instantiated in the steering model whenever capabilities and architectural deltas are calculated.
forces: Agent-generated outputs become opaque over time without provenance
Debugging hallucinated requirements requires tracing the exact prompt inputs that generated them
patterns.solution: Structure capability models to include CapabilityLineage and CapabilityRecord metadata capturing source references and timestamps.
implementation_signals: CapabilityLineage and CapabilityRecord models with parent/origin references

evidence.note: Formal models defining capability tracking and lineage across modifications.

benefits: Facilitates root cause analysis for incorrect architectural updates
costs: Increases complexity and storage size of knowledge indexes
failure_modes: Lineage identifiers break when parent records are pruned or renamed

patterns.reuse_notes: Essential pattern for enterprise agents generating decisions, code, or documentation.

patterns.name: Diagnostic Health Reflection Loop

tool_protocols.notes: Evaluates system governance health through quantitative heuristics and traceable metrics.

optimisation_targets.notes: Surfaces actionable health degradation signals to agents and human operators.

simplicity_vs_autonomy.rationale: Calculates health scores deterministically from metrics rather than subjective LLM evaluation.

patterns.summary: Computes health status and structured explanations over governance and pipeline metrics to provide reflective feedback for subsequent runs.
patterns.intent: Provide quantitative feedback on steering efficacy and flag degradation in repository architecture health.
patterns.context: Embedded in the dashboard and runner telemetry loop to evaluate governance vitality.
forces: Steering processes may execute successfully at runtime while underlying system architecture degrades
Agents require objective feedback metrics to calibrate future decisions
patterns.solution: Define calculate_health and get_health_reasons functions mapping inventory and throughput metrics to HealthStatus states.
implementation_signals: calculate_health function assessing metrics against thresholds

evidence.note: Evaluates health state and returns explanatory reason strings.
Data structures representing aggregate health score and constituent metrics.

benefits: Clear visibility into system degradation trends
Standardized diagnostic outputs suitable for agent self-correction prompts
costs: Scoring weights must be tuned to avoid false alarms
failure_modes: Metrics fail to capture domain-specific deterioration if thresholds are set too loose

patterns.reuse_notes: Adaptable to any autonomous system requiring continuous monitoring and self-reflective feedback.

patterns.name: Template-Driven Heuristic Evolution

tool_protocols.notes: Guides promotion of empirical observations to formal patterns via markdown templates.

optimisation_targets.notes: Standardizes how agents and humans formalize emerging engineering heuristics.

simplicity_vs_autonomy.rationale: Leverages structured template formats to guide LLM and human documentation.

patterns.summary: Codifies a progressive evolution lifecycle where informal heuristics are promoted to verified patterns using structured markdown templates.
patterns.intent: Prevent premature codification of unverified patterns while creating a clear pipeline from observation to formal rule.
patterns.context: Governs the knowledge repository under cas-knowledge/templates/ and pattern evolution flows.
forces: Directly creating rigid patterns leads to overfitted architecture rules
Unstructured heuristics get lost without a formalized promotion path
patterns.solution: Use standardized evolution templates (heuristic-to-pattern, experiment, decision) that enforce evidence collection before promotion.
implementation_signals: Flow documentation describing pattern lifecycle promotion

evidence.note: Template defining criteria and format for promoting an observed heuristic to a pattern.
Describes the operational lifecycle flow from signal to heuristic to pattern.

benefits: High signal-to-noise ratio in catalogued patterns
Standardized schema simplifies automated extraction and verification
costs: Requires human or validation gate before heuristic reaches pattern status
failure_modes: Heuristics remain in limbo if validation gates or experiments are not executed

patterns.reuse_notes: Use this template pattern to structure organizational memory and prompt collections.

patterns.name: Sequential Pipeline Flow Runner

tool_protocols.notes: Orchestrates step execution linearly passing configuration and shared state context.

optimisation_targets.notes: Maintains predictable linear execution ordering across steering stages.

simplicity_vs_autonomy.rationale: Avoids complex async or swarm coordination in favor of verifiable multi-step execution.

patterns.summary: Executes steering routines as a sequential pipeline where discrete stages read, process, and mutate execution context under top-level supervision.
patterns.intent: Coordinate multi-stage steering processes predictably with unified error handling and context propagation.
patterns.context: The central execution entry point in src/cas_runner/runner.py invoked by CLI commands.
forces: Complex distributed orchestration is difficult to trace and debug in CI environments
Steering phases depend strictly on output artifacts produced by previous stages
patterns.solution: FlowRunner coordinates sequential execution of workspace initialization, compliance checks, agentic merging, and index compilation.
implementation_signals: Methods coordinating distinct execution phases in fixed order

evidence.note: Main execution coordinator organizing workflow steps and error propagation.
Sequence diagram documenting linear orchestration of cas-runner stages.

benefits: Deterministic execution trace and clear phase failure points
Simple error handling and clean rollback on fatal errors
costs: Lack of concurrency can increase run latency for large multi-repo workspaces
failure_modes: A failure in an early phase blocks all subsequent non-dependent diagnostic steps

patterns.reuse_notes: Recommended for CLI tools and continuous delivery bots needing deterministic state transitions.

anti_patterns.name: Unbounded Agentic Merge Drift
symptoms: Disappearance of subtle architectural constraints during automated knowledge merges
Creeping divergence between actual code capabilities and synthesized governance summaries
LLM generating plausible-sounding resolutions that silently discard critical edge cases

where_observed.note: Reconciles governance blocks without mandatory deterministic semantic diff assertions post-merge.

impact: Silent loss of governance requirements and architectural drift across project releases
suggested_remediation: Introduce post-merge semantic assertion checks ensuring every invariant present in parent branches exists in the resolved output
Require human-in-the-loop signoff for any merge resolving high-risk governance blocks

anti_patterns.name: Mock Client Behavioral Parity Gap
symptoms: CI tests passing smoothly with MockLLMClient while production runs fail on LiteLLM completions
Mock client returning perfectly formatted JSON while real models return markdown code fences or malformed schemas
No simulation of token limit truncation or rate limiting in test environments

where_observed.note: Provides static simulated responses that do not reflect production LLM failure modes.

impact: Uncaught schema parse errors and edge case crashes in automated production workflows
suggested_remediation: Fuzz the mock client with malformed outputs, markdown fences, and latency spikes
Run periodic contract tests with recorded production response cassettes

cross_cutting_concerns.approach: Structured Pydantic models define both input facts (PromptFact) and output schemas (ResolutionResult, GovernanceAction) ensuring contract stability across LLM boundaries.
cross_cutting_concerns.notes: Minimizes prompt injection risks and format drift across varying backend models.

cross_cutting_concerns.approach: Telemetry metrics tracked via OpenTelemetry SDK alongside calculated domain health scores (GovernanceHealth) derived from runtime evaluation.
cross_cutting_concerns.notes: Combines system-level tracing with domain-specific architecture health evaluation.

open_questions.question: How are concurrent branch updates resolved if multiple agent runs trigger simultaneously on shared governance repositories?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Concurrent merges using AgenticMerger on the same workspace could cause race conditions or conflicting commits in Git.
open_questions.evidence_gap: Repository shows sequential FlowRunner and CLI commands, but distributed locking mechanism across CI runners was not found in cas_runner code.
open_questions.suggested_next_check: Inspect GitHub Actions workflow files (.github/workflows/cas-*.yml) to determine concurrency grouping or job queue constraints.
